title: Logarithmic characteristic class and generator-image subgroup
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme with an etale log structure $L$ [def-trf-fs-log-blowup], and let $s:\operatorname{Spec}\Omega\to S$ be a geometric point with $\Omega$ algebraically closed; geometric stalks are the pointed-etale colimits of [def-weil-pbc-geometric-stalks]. Put $\overline L_s=L_s/L_s^\times$ and $C_s=\overline L_s^{\rm gp}$. Define the characteristic-class homomorphism $\operatorname{cl}_s:L_s\to C_s$ as the quotient by units followed by the canonical map to group completion. Now let $f:(X,M)\to(Y,N)$ be a morphism of locally Noetherian fs log schemes [def-trf-fs-log-blowup], let $x:\operatorname{Spec}\Omega\to X$ be a geometric point, let $Q$ be a commutative monoid, and let $\beta:Q\to N(Y)$ be a monoid homomorphism. Write $b:Q\to M_x$ for its section pullback followed by the geometric germ, namely the canonical base-chart germ of [def-per-log-differential-stalk]. For $r\geq0$ and $t:\{1,\ldots,r\}\to M_x$, define the generator-image subgroup of $\overline M_x^{\rm gp}$ by $H(f,x,\beta,t)=\langle\{\operatorname{cl}_x(t_i):1\leq i\leq r\}\cup\{\operatorname{cl}_x(b(q)):q\in Q\}\rangle$. The empty family is allowed and gives exactly the image of the induced homomorphism $Q^{\rm gp}\to\overline M_x^{\rm gp}$. These definitions impose no log-smoothness condition and no chart, sharpness or finiteness condition on $\beta$ or $Q$.
